messages:
sarah.docs: Heads-up — I opened a docs PR to update the SDK examples for the new "cursor resume" helper that smooths streaming + pagination interop. PR: https://git.redwood.ai/r/redwood/docs/pulls/402 :eyes:
jun.eng: Nice. What's the concrete change users will see?
david.sdk: Short version: old pattern used manual offsets + ad-hoc retry loops. New helper centralizes resume token handling, TTL awareness, and backpressure-safe retries. Example for Python added.
lee.ts: Can you paste the TS snippet here so I can sanity-check the API surface?
david.sdk: Sure — TS example from the new docs:
```ts
// resumeHelper wraps stream + paginate, yields messages until cursor exhausted
for await (const chunk of resumeHelper(client, { model: 'x', pageSize: 256 })) {
  process(chunk)
}
```
marco.go: Go needs an example that shows context cancellation and how the helper surfaces transient retry errors. I'll add one.
sarah.docs: The PR includes a migration note titled "From manual cursors to resumeHelper" and a short checklist for docs maintainers (update codeblock, add link to SDK changelog, run quick local snippet).
jun.eng: Any behavioral regressions we should call out? e.g., TTL or ordering differences.
david.sdk: Good call — there's one subtlety: resumeHelper will drop in-memory prefix cache if the cursor TTL expired; it will return a RecoverableCursorError so callers can choose a fallback model variant. We documented that and gave an example fallback policy.
lee.ts: I noticed a small mismatch in the TS types in the PR review comments — I left an inline suggestion. Also added a note to show how to use the helper with streaming responses (streaming -> chunks -> resume token).
marco.go: Added a Go test showing cancel mid-stream and verifying no goroutine leaks. Pushed to branch.
kai.eng: I'll review runtime implications (kernel selection + KV cache) tomorrow — assigned myself. If runtime needs a tweak, we should land docs + SDK together.
doc-bot: deploy-bot: doc preview built: https://docs-preview.redwood.ai/cursor-resume-helper — artifacts: 1 changed page, 3 snippets updated.
sarah.docs: Awesome. Request: whoever merges please squash commits and include short changelog blurb: "docs: add resumeHelper examples for Python/TS/Go, explain TTL and fallback behavior".
david.sdk: I'll follow up with a small SDK patch that exports the helper in the top-level package and adds a deprecation notice for the older manual utility.
jun.eng: Sounds good. If anyone hits blockers ping me and I'll try to prioritize a runtime follow-up. :thumbsup:
file_description: coord for new cursor-resume helper examples across Python/TS/Go, migration notes, PR and review coordination
